import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Select relevant spending columns
spending_columns = ['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']

# Calculate average spending per category
avg_spending = df[spending_columns].mean()

# Create bar plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.barplot(x=avg_spending.index, y=avg_spending.values)
plt.title('Average Customer Spending by Product Category', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Average Spending (€)', fontsize=12)
plt.xlabel('Product Category', fontsize=12)
plt.xticks(rotation=45, fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the visualization
plt.savefig('output.png')
